name: Pipi
source:
Ninkendo's portable type
The latest type of consumer doll!

It is the latest model of portable consumer doll made by Ninkendo Co., Ltd. and released by 'Portable Consumer Doll.'
The software lineup includes an electronic dictionary, cooking guide, brain training, and learning software. The AI's thinking is basically that of a genius or a doctor with the personality of a little sassy girl who likes to talk a lot of nonsense.

[From Pikopiko's official website]
